clippings.speaker: James Cameron
clippings.quote: I was petrified of you. I had been writing for months with your picture up on the wall right in front of my little writing station. I was desperately trying to channel what you and Ridley had created for Ripley, and extrapolate forward with my own post-traumatic-stress-syndrome motif.
clippings.title: Aliens 40th Cast Reunion: ‘We’re Still The Same Punks We Were Then,’ Says James Cameron
clippings.context: Cameron to Weaver in Empire's 40th-anniversary Aliens reunion interview, recalling their first meeting.

clippings.speaker: Sigourney Weaver
clippings.quote: Because I read this script that came out of nowhere by this person James Cameron, and it was one of the most extraordinarily structured, thematic, loaded scripts I’d ever read. I felt like it was this beautiful aria between Ripley and the Alien Queen.
clippings.title: Aliens 40th Cast Reunion: ‘We’re Still The Same Punks We Were Then,’ Says James Cameron
clippings.context: Weaver in Empire's Aliens reunion interview, recalling first reading Cameron's script.

clippings.speaker: Sigourney Weaver
clippings.quote: And I was thrilled that Jim would entrust me with such a character. I felt an immediate connection to her. I knew it would be probably the biggest challenge I’ve ever taken on, but I thought, with his help, with his amazing writing, with our wonderful cast, I would definitely give it my best shot.
clippings.title: Sigourney Weaver on Playing Kiri in Avatar: The Way of Water
clippings.context: Weaver on how Cameron pitched her the teenage Na'vi role of Kiri over lunch in 2010.

clippings.speaker: James Cameron
clippings.quote: I thought, 'Wow, if we could do that, what if Sigourney played her own daughter, or at least the daughter of her avatar self?' … I said, 'Sigourney, are you up for this? You want to try playing a 15-year-old?' And we'd joke about it. I'd say, 'Well, emotionally you're 15.' And so am I, by the way, I think we all are to some extent.
clippings.title: James Cameron Marvels at How Sigourney Weaver Played a Teen in “Avatar: Fire and Ash”: She Was 'a Different Person' (Exclusive)
clippings.context: Cameron to People, explaining his decision to cast Weaver as the teenage Kiri after she played Grace in Avatar.

clippings.speaker: Sigourney Weaver
clippings.quote: In fact, I don't really think he tells us where we're going. He wants to find out through us where the character is going, and that's why he's not in video village or anything … He is right there with us. … He does everything possible to make sure you get to try everything you want to try. So, it's kind of like the perfect job for an actor.
clippings.title: Sigourney Weaver says working with James Cameron on the Avatar series is "like the perfect job for an actor": "He does everything possible to make sure you get to try everything you want to try"
clippings.context: Weaver to GamesRadar+ in London on how Cameron directs performance-capture scenes in the Volume.

clippings.speaker: James Cameron
clippings.quote: We kind of meet in that sort of quest for perfection … She's amazing. She always brings it every time.
clippings.title: James Cameron Reflects on Decades-Long Friendship, Working Relationship with Sigourney Weaver (Exclusive)
clippings.context: Cameron to People at the Saturn Awards in March 2026, on his decades-long working relationship with Weaver.
